sentences.japanese: 衣服を大事にすれば、ずっと永く保つ。
sentences.english: If you look after your clothes, they last a lot longer.

sentences.japanese: われわれは一度だけ死ぬ、そしてそんなにも永い間死ぬ。
sentences.english: We die only once, and for such a long time.

sentences.japanese: 恥を忍んで生き永らえるよりむしろ死にたい。
sentences.english: I would die before I live on in shame.

sentences.japanese: 喧嘩は落度が一方にだけある場合には、永くは続かないであろう。
sentences.english: Quarrels would not last long if the fault were only on one side.
